21:     if user.wild?
22:       next !battle.pbCanRun?(user.index) || user.battler.allAllies.length > 0

27: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("SwitchOutUserStatusMove",
28:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
29:     # Wild Pokémon run from battle - generally don't prefer (don't want to end the battle too easily)
30:     next score - 20 if user.wild?
31:     # Trainer-owned Pokémon switch out
32:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("ReserveLastPokemon") && battle.pbTeamAbleNonActiveCount(user.index) == 1
33:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE   # Don't switch in ace
34:     end
35:     # Prefer if the user switching out will lose a negative effect
36:     score += 20 if user.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] > 0
37:     score += 10 if user.effects[PBEffects::Confusion] > 1
38:     score += 10 if user.effects[PBEffects::Attract] >= 0
39:     # Consider the user's stat stages
40:     if user.stages.any? { |key, val| val >= 2 }
41:       score -= 15
42:     elsif user.stages.any? { |key, val| val < 0 }
43:       score += 10
44:     end
45:     # Consider the user's end of round damage/healing
46:     eor_damage = user.rough_end_of_round_damage
47:     score += 15 if eor_damage > 0
48:     score -= 15 if eor_damage < 0
49:     # Prefer if the user doesn't have any damaging moves
50:     score += 10 if !user.check_for_move { |m| m.damagingMove? }
51:     # Don't prefer if the user's side has entry hazards on it
52:     score -= 10 if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Spikes] > 0
53:     score -= 10 if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::ToxicSpikes] > 0
54:     score -= 10 if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::StealthRock]
55:     next score
56:   }
57: )

120: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("SwitchOutUserPassOnEffects",

122:     # Don't want to switch in ace
123:     score -= 20 if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("ReserveLastPokemon") &&
124:                    battle.pbTeamAbleNonActiveCount(user.index) == 1
125:     # Don't prefer if the user will pass on a negative effect
126:     score -= 10 if user.effects[PBEffects::Confusion] > 1
127:     score -= 15 if user.effects[PBEffects::Curse]
128:     score -= 10 if user.effects[PBEffects::Embargo] > 1
129:     score -= 15 if user.effects[PBEffects::GastroAcid]
130:     score -= 10 if user.effects[PBEffects::HealBlock] > 1
131:     score -= 10 if user.effects[PBEffects::LeechSeed] >= 0
132:     score -= 20 if user.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] > 0
133:     # Prefer if the user will pass on a positive effect
134:     score += 10 if user.effects[PBEffects::AquaRing]
135:     score += 10 if user.effects[PBEffects::FocusEnergy] > 0
136:     score += 10 if user.effects[PBEffects::Ingrain]
137:     score += 8 if user.effects[PBEffects::MagnetRise] > 1
138:     score += 10 if user.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0
139:     # Consider the user's stat stages
140:     if user.stages.any? { |key, val| val >= 4 }
141:       score += 25
142:     elsif user.stages.any? { |key, val| val >= 2 }
143:       score += 15
144:     elsif user.stages.any? { |key, val| val < 0 }
145:       score -= 15
146:     end
147:     # Consider the user's end of round damage/healing
148:     eor_damage = user.rough_end_of_round_damage
149:     score += 15 if eor_damage > 0
150:     score -= 15 if eor_damage < 0
151:     # Prefer if the user doesn't have any damaging moves
152:     score += 15 if !user.check_for_move { |m| m.damagingMove? }
153:     # Don't prefer if the user's side has entry hazards on it
154:     score -= 10 if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Spikes] > 0
155:     score -= 10 if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::ToxicSpikes] > 0
156:     score -= 10 if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::StealthRock]

158:   }

169: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("SwitchOutTargetStatusMove",
170:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
171:     # Ends the battle - generally don't prefer (don't want to end the battle too easily)
172:     next score - 10 if target.wild?
173:     # Switches the target out
174:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if target.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] > 0
175:     # Don't prefer if target is at low HP and could be knocked out instead
176:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
177:       score -= 10 if target.hp <= target.totalhp / 3
178:     end
179:     # Consider the target's stat stages
180:     if target.stages.any? { |key, val| val >= 2 }
181:       score += 15
182:     elsif target.stages.any? { |key, val| val < 0 }
183:       score -= 15
184:     end
185:     # Consider the target's end of round damage/healing
186:     eor_damage = target.rough_end_of_round_damage
187:     score -= 15 if eor_damage > 0
188:     score += 15 if eor_damage < 0
189:     # Prefer if the target's side has entry hazards on it
190:     score += 10 if target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Spikes] > 0
191:     score += 10 if target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::ToxicSpikes] > 0
192:     score += 10 if target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::StealthRock]
193:     next score
194:   }
195: )

200: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("SwitchOutTargetDamagingMove",
201:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
202:     next score if target.wild?
203:     # No score modification if the target can't be made to switch out
204:     next score if !battle.moldBreaker && target.has_active_ability?(:SUCTIONCUPS)
205:     next score if target.effects[PBEffects::Ingrain]
206:     # No score modification if the target can't be replaced
207:     can_switch = false
208:     battle.eachInTeamFromBattlerIndex(target.index) do |_pkmn, i|
209:       can_switch = battle.pbCanSwitchIn?(target.index, i)
210:       break if can_switch
211:     end
212:     next score if !can_switch
213:     # Not score modification if the target has a Substitute
214:     next score if target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0
215:     # Don't want to switch out the target if it will faint from Perish Song
216:     score -= 20 if target.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] > 0
217:     # Consider the target's stat stages
218:     if target.stages.any? { |key, val| val >= 2 }
219:       score += 15
220:     elsif target.stages.any? { |key, val| val < 0 }
221:       score -= 15
222:     end
223:     # Consider the target's end of round damage/healing
224:     eor_damage = target.rough_end_of_round_damage
225:     score -= 15 if eor_damage > 0
226:     score += 15 if eor_damage < 0
227:     # Prefer if the target's side has entry hazards on it
228:     score += 10 if target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Spikes] > 0
229:     score += 10 if target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::ToxicSpikes] > 0
230:     score += 10 if target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::StealthRock]
231:     next score
232:   }
233: )

238: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("BindTarget",
239:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
240:     next score if target.effects[PBEffects::Trapping] > 0
241:     next score if target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0
242:     # Prefer if the user has a Binding Band or Grip Claw (because why have it if
243:     # you don't want to use it?)
244:     score += 5 if user.has_active_item?([:BINDINGBAND, :GRIPCLAW])
245:     # Target will take damage at the end of each round from the binding
246:     score += 10 if target.battler.takesIndirectDamage?
247:     # Check whether the target will be trapped in battle by the binding
248:     if target.can_become_trapped?
249:       score += 8   # Prefer if the target will become trapped by this move
250:       eor_damage = target.rough_end_of_round_damage
251:       if eor_damage > 0
252:         # Prefer if the target will take damage at the end of each round on top
253:         # of binding damage
254:         score += 10
255:       elsif eor_damage < 0
256:         # Don't prefer if the target will heal itself at the end of each round
257:         score -= 10
258:       end
259:       # Prefer if the target has been Perish Songed
260:       score += 15 if target.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] > 0
261:     end
262:     # Don't prefer if the target can remove the binding (and the binding has an
263:     # effect)
264:     if target.can_become_trapped? || target.battler.takesIndirectDamage?
265:       if ai.trainer.medium_skill? &&
266:          target.has_move_with_function?("RemoveUserBindingAndEntryHazards")
267:         score -= 10
268:       end
269:     end
270:     next score
271:   }
272: )

288: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveFailureAgainstTargetCheck.add("TrapTargetInBattle",
289:   proc { |move, user, target, ai, battle|
290:     next false if move.damagingMove?
291:     next true if target.effects[PBEffects::MeanLook] >= 0
292:     next true if Settings::MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS && target.has_type?(:GHOST)
293:     next false
294:   }
295: )
296: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("TrapTargetInBattle",
297:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
298:     if !target.can_become_trapped? || !battle.pbCanChooseNonActive?(target.index)
299:       next (move.damagingMove?) ? score : Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
300:     end
301:     # Not worth trapping if target will faint this round anyway
302:     eor_damage = target.rough_end_of_round_damage
303:     if eor_damage >= target.hp
304:       next (move.damagingMove?) ? score : Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
305:     end
306:     # Not worth trapping if target can remove the binding
307:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill? &&
308:        target.has_move_with_function?("RemoveUserBindingAndEntryHazards")
309:       next (move.damagingMove?) ? score : Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
310:     end
311:     # Score for being an additional effect
312:     add_effect = move.get_score_change_for_additional_effect(user, target)
313:     next score if add_effect == -999   # Additional effect will be negated
314:     score += add_effect
315:     # Score for target becoming trapped in battle
316:     if target.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] > 0 ||
317:        target.effects[PBEffects::Attract] >= 0 ||
318:        target.effects[PBEffects::Confusion] > 0 ||
319:        eor_damage > 0
320:       score += 15
